type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

  camera: FreeCamera;

const EPS = 1e-6;
const EPS2 = EPS * EPS;

type MutableVec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };
type ObservableLike = MutableVec & {
  set?: (x: number, y: number, z: number) => void;
  markDirty?: () => void;
};

function finite(v: Vec): boolean {
  return Number.isFinite(v.x) && Number.isFinite(v.y) && Number.isFinite(v.z);
}

function lengthSq(v: Vec): number {
  return v.x*v.x + v.y*v.y + v.z*v.z;
}

function dot(a: Vec, b: Vec): number { ... }

function cross(a,b): Vec { ... }

function normalize(v: Vec): Vec | null {
  if (!finite(v)) return null;
  const lenSq = lengthSq(v);
  if (lenSq <= EPS2) return null;
  const inv = 1 / Math.sqrt(lenSq);
  return { x: v.x*inv, y: v.y*inv, z: v.z*inv };
}

function perpendicularComponent(v: Vec, f: Vec): Vec | null {
  // f should be unit

  const d = dot(v, f);
  const p = { x: v.x - d*f.x, y: v.y - d*f.y, z: v.z - d*f.z };
  const lenSq = lengthSq(p);
  if (lenSq <= EPS2) return null;
  const inv = 1 / Math.sqrt(lenSq);
  return { x: p.x*inv, y: p.y*inv, z: p.z*inv };
}

  return normalize(alt) ?? {x:0,y:1,z:0};
}

import type { FreeCamera } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { createBankedFreeCamera } from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface ChaseCamera {
  camera: FreeCamera;
  bank(up: Vec): void;
}

const EPS = 1e-6;
const EPS2 = EPS * EPS;

type MutableVec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };
type ObservableLike = MutableVec & {
  set?: (x: number, y: number, z: number) => void;
  copy?: (v: MutableVec) => void;
  markDirty?: () => void;
};

function finite(v: Vec): boolean {
  return Number.isFinite(v.x) && Number.isFinite(v.y) && Number.isFinite(v.z);
}

function dot(a: Vec, b: Vec): number {
  return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

function cross(a: Vec, b: Vec): Vec {
  return {
    x: a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
    y: a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
    z: a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x,
  };
}

function normalize(v: Vec): Vec | null {
  if (!finite(v)) return null;
  const max = Math.max(Math.abs(v.x), Math.abs(v.y), Math.abs(v.z));
  if (!Number.isFinite(max) || max <= EPS) return null;
  const sx = v.x / max;
  const sy = v.y / max;
  const sz = v.z / max;
  const len = Math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy + sz * sz);
  if (!Number.isFinite(len) || len <= EPS) return null;
  const inv = 1 / (len * max);
  return { x: v.x * inv, y: v.y * inv, z: v.z * inv };
}

function perpendicularComponent(v: Vec, f: Vec): Vec | null {
  if (!finite(v) || !finite(f)) return null;
  const d = dot(v, f);
  const px = v.x - d * f.x;
  const py = v.y - d * f.y;
  const pz = v.z - d * f.z;
  const lenSq = px * px + py * py + pz * pz;
  if (!Number.isFinite(lenSq) || lenSq <= EPS2) return null;
  const inv = 1 / Math.sqrt(lenSq);
  return { x: px * inv, y: py * inv, z: pz * inv };
}

function arbitraryPerp(f: Vec): Vec {
  const axes: MutableVec[] = [
    { x: 1, y: 0, z: 0 },
    { x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 },
    { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 },
  ];
  let best = axes[0];
  let bestScore = Math.abs(dot(f, best));
  for (const axis of axes) {
    const score = Math.abs(dot(f, axis));
    if (score < bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      best = axis;
    }
  }
  const result = normalize(cross(f, best));
  if (result) return result;
  const fallback =
    perpendicularComponent({ x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 }, f) ??
    perpendicularComponent({ x: 1, y: 0, z: 0 }, f) ??
    perpendicularComponent({ x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 }, f);
  return fallback ?? { x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 };
}

function stableUp(f: Vec, preferred?: Vec | null): Vec {
  const attempts: Vec[] = [];
  if (preferred) attempts.push(preferred);
  attempts.push({ x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 }, { x: 1, y: 0, z: 0 }, { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 });
  for (const attempt of attempts) {
    const result = perpendicularComponent(attempt, f);
    if (result) return result;
  }
  return arbitraryPerp(f);
}

function getObservableLike(cam: FreeCamera, key: string): ObservableLike | null {
  const value = (cam as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
  return value ? (value as ObservableLike) : null;
}

function setVec(vec: ObservableLike | null | undefined, v: Vec): void {
  if (!vec) return;
  if (typeof vec.set === "function") {
    vec.set(v.x, v.y, v.z);
  } else if (typeof vec.copy === "function") {
    vec.copy(v);
  } else {
    vec.x = v.x;
    vec.y = v.y;
    vec.z = v.z;
  }
  if (typeof vec.markDirty === "function") vec.markDirty();
}

function readVec(vec: ObservableLike | null | undefined): Vec | null {
  if (!vec) return null;
  const result = normalize({ x: vec.x, y: vec.y, z: vec.z });
  return result;
}

export function createChaseCamera(eye: Vec, target: Vec): ChaseCamera {
  const e = { x: eye.x, y: eye.y, z: eye.z };
  const t = { x: target.x, y: target.y, z: target.z };
  const initialForward = normalize({ x: t.x - e.x, y: t.y - e.y, z: t.z - e.z });
  const initialUp = initialForward ? stableUp(initialForward) : { x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 };

  const camera = createBankedFreeCamera(e, t, initialUp) as FreeCamera;
  let lastUp = { ...initialUp };

  // Ensure the returned camera really starts at eye/target and upright.
  setVec(getObservableLike(camera, "position"), e);
  setVec(getObservableLike(camera, "target"), t);
  setVec(getObservableLike(camera, "upVector"), lastUp);

  return {
    camera,
    bank(up: Vec): void {
      const u = normalize(up);
      if (!u) return;

      const position = getObservableLike(camera, "position");
      const lookAt = getObservableLike(camera, "target");
      if (!position || !lookAt) return;

      const forward = normalize({
        x: lookAt.x - position.x,
        y: lookAt.y - position.y,
        z: lookAt.z - position.z,
      });
      if (!forward) return;

      const desired = perpendicularComponent(u, forward);
      if (desired) {
        lastUp = desired;
        setVec(getObservableLike(camera, "upVector"), desired);
        return;
      }

      // Singularity: up is along (or opposite) the line of sight. Keep the
      // previous roll, using the camera's current upVector if it is readable.
      const previous = readVec(getObservableLike(camera, "upVector")) ?? lastUp;
      const preserved = perpendicularComponent(previous, forward);
      if (preserved) {
        lastUp = preserved;
        setVec(getObservableLike(camera, "upVector"), preserved);
        return;
      }

      const fallback = stableUp(forward, previous);
      lastUp = fallback;
      setVec(getObservableLike(camera, "upVector"), fallback);
    },
  };
}

import { createBankedFreeCamera } from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface ChaseCamera {
  camera: FreeCamera;
  bank(up: Vec): void;

const EPS = 1e-6;
const EPS2 = EPS * EPS;

type MutableVec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };
type ObservableLike = MutableVec & {
  set?: (x: number, y: number, z: number) => void;
  copy?: (v: MutableVec) => void;
  markDirty?: () => void;
};

function finite(v: Vec): boolean {
  return Number.isFinite(v.x) && Number.isFinite(v.y) && Number.isFinite(v.z);
}

function dot(a: Vec, b: Vec): number {
  return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

function cross(a: Vec, b: Vec): Vec {
  return {
    x: a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
    y: a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
    z: a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x,
  };
}

function normalize(v: Vec): Vec | null {
  if (!finite(v)) return null;
  const max = Math.max(Math.abs(v.x), Math.abs(v.y), Math.abs(v.z));
  if (!Number.isFinite(max) || max <= EPS) return null;
  const sx = v.x / max;
  const sy = v.y / max;
  const sz = v.z / max;
  const len = Math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy + sz * sz);
  if (!Number.isFinite(len) || len <= EPS) return null;
  const inv = 1 / (len * max);
  return { x: v.x * inv, y: v.y * inv, z: v.z * inv };
}

function perpendicularComponent(v: Vec, f: Vec): Vec | null {
  if (!finite(v) || !finite(f)) return null;
  const d = dot(v, f);
  const px = v.x - d * f.x;
  const py = v.y - d * f.y;
  const pz = v.z - d * f.z;
  const lenSq = px * px + py * py + pz * pz;
  if (!Number.isFinite(lenSq) || lenSq <= EPS2) return null;
  const inv = 1 / Math.sqrt(lenSq);
  return { x: px * inv, y: py * inv, z: pz * inv };
}
